notes: loadModel from a local file: no handler-level gauges (totalLoadTime, modelInitializationTime) were reported; load times are the RPC phases server.handlerExecution (inside the QVAC worker) and totalClientTime.

transcribe(): the profiler records time only (no token or real-time-factor gauges for this operation); those numbers come from the same call's own stats (transcribe().stats), recorded per clip as sdk_stats.

completion: the profiler event carries time, ttfb, modelExecutionTime and the stream chunk count, but no timeToFirstToken or tokensPerSecond gauge; those, and the prompt/cache/generated token counts, come from the same call's completion stats (completion().final.stats, kept by src/llm.js).
ocr: the OCR addon reports detectionTime, recognitionTime and totalTime in SECONDS (they match modelExecutionTime / 1000); profiler.exportTable() prints them with an ms unit.

transcribe().stats: totalTime is reported in SECONDS on this build (it equals totalWallMs / 1000), although the SDK schema describes it as ms; audioDuration, whisperEncodeTime and whisperDecodeTime are in ms.
OCR and transcription report no time to first token: they return one result per call (whisper reports its token count and tokens/s in transcribe().stats; OCR reports no tokens).
rpc.connection: the SDK client connected to its QVAC worker 2 time(s) (674 ms, during step none; 721 ms, during step 72).

Memory: qvac_process_mb is the SDK resource gauge (processUsedBytes of the QVAC worker), sampled once per profiled operation, not a high-water mark. Hard peaks under a cgroup cap: README, "Runs in 3 GB".
